question_text: Changes introduced in the updated control plan for residues of pharmacologically active substances, pesticides and contaminants.

Contact Details: Please (re)confirm the name and address of the central competent authority (or authorities) and provide updated details of the contact point for correspondence on the control plan for residues of pharmacologically active substances, pesticides and contaminants (e-mail addresses, phone details etc.).

Please provide updated production data for the animals and products of animal origin covered by the control plan for pharmacologically active substances, pesticides and contaminants. Please indicate if the number of planned samples has increased or decreased relative to the previous year’s plans.

If there have been changes in the information covered under points A to M of Part II of Annex I to Regulation (EU) 2022/2292 which was *previously* provided with last year’s plan, please provide details. If no changes have occurred, please provide a statement to that effect.
